premises: Pt atoms in dilute CuPt/SBA-15 locate at the metal-support interface, not the surface
Subsurface Pt remotely modifies the electronic structure of surface Cu atoms
This electronic modification lowers the H2 dissociation barrier on Cu
The electronic modification alters adsorption energies to favor C=O over C=C hydrogenation
